notes: The first two full suites preserve font warning failures; the first also preserves a palette loop. The third preserves the failed hidden-subtree inline-image test at DPR2; the corrected test observes actual window pixels.
The source scope and stock footer in single-profile diagnostic runners are inherited text; their exact loop overrides, filenames and expectedSessions=1 are authoritative.
The first operator failed in its host observer before any clicks and was explicitly stopped; its original record has no container exit code.

The full 29-target suite uses producer 14; its library installation and component test binary are byte-identical to producer 15. Producer 15 adds a fixture-only alpha-capable rectangle and passes all three affected catalog/configuration targets.

The explicit texture-dimensions experiment was rejected. The final candidate uses asynchronous GPU capsule paths, GUI-thread image resources, independent natural text measurement and source-measured sharp-rectangle paint snapping with an alpha-capable fixture texture.
